V150-R3-BOOT-RECOVERY-R12-INTEGRATED
LAB PR #257 critical boot-loop recovery. The earlier #256 signature LAB was based on master and omitted R12 CYD32 adaptive framebuffer allocation. This build combines R12 guarded FULL8 / 2-4-8-16-band / direct-panel boot fallback with v1.50 Wyze, SimpliSafe, HC-05 metadata, device info and emulator coverage.
Require exact-head full host tests (device info), R10/R11/R12/v150 regressions, CYD 2.8 and CYD 3.2 firmware matrix, emulator, OTA reserves; build and release LAB firmware to web flasher after all gates pass.
Hardware gate: CYD3.2 SD-in 3 cold boots, WiFi/GPS/BLE/SquachMesh, 60s animations and rotation; CYD2.8 smoke. No production merge, tag, branch deletion or SquachEmit changes.
